body:
Applied the approved light UI direction through shared visual tokens and a small Svelte component set across all workspace views, resource editors, auxiliary dialogs and pairing. The card checklist now has a compact shared panel, completion count, inline editing and accessible remove/reorder controls. Existing autosave, conditional writes, recovery, planning and drag behavior remain intact.

The broad HTTPS browser smoke, planning browser checks and all 11 Chromium regression suites pass. Focus and dialogs were checked again after the mobile navigation/filter refinement. The running manual app was visually reviewed at 1440px, 390px and 320px, including dark appearance. No unit tests or dependencies were added. Browser emulation does not establish physical iPhone/Safari acceptance.

Evidence: progress/2026-09-25-ui-system.md. Component guidance: docs/DESIGN-SYSTEM.md. The existing dev endpoint serves the rebuilt assets without network configuration changes.

metadata.summary: Applied a shared Astra UI system and polished the card checklist
